verdict.rationale: Raygun documents mute/ignore rules (ignore for a time period, number of occurrences, or by rule) which directly support suppressing noisy repeat errors, and it integrates with PagerDuty/Slack for incident routing. However, there is no evidence of explicit 'spike protection' (detecting and throttling a sudden burst of the same error) or per-key/per-error rate limiting on notifications themselves — only ignore conditions on already-grouped errors. missing for 10: spike/burst-detection protection, per-key notification rate limits, documented anti-flood alerting mechanism.
